P.text: A trade is evaluated by a zero-cost trade check in the CLOB contract that uses a bitwise AND operation to determine whether either token amount is zero.
P.evidence_quote: it uses a bitwise AND operation to determine whether either token amount is zero

I.text: The zero-cost trade check should only flag trades where a token amount is actually zero, not legitimate trades with non-zero amounts.
I.evidence_quote: a & b == 0 returns true even when both a and b are non-zero, as long as they have disjoint binary representations

V.text: Legitimate trades with disjoint non-zero binary values revert with ZeroCostTrade(), enabling DoS on matching logic, inability to take certain valid limit orders, and market liveness failures.
V.evidence_quote: This causes legitimate trades to revert with a ZeroCostTrade() error.
